mapping_policy.publication_boundary: A source relationship is not a HECAVEX incident finding. Mappings without adequate procedure context remain unmapped or explicitly uncertain.

change_history.summary: Published 4628 official actor procedure relationships across 176 groups, expanded operational guidance to 20 techniques and materialised 20 detection engineering packages.

Replaced the matrix-first explorer with three staged analyst workflows: evidence candidates must become a documented assessment, defensive coverage is recorded by capability dimension, and actor research stays inline through sourced context and operational use. Added the complete official Enterprise ATT&CK group directory and portable incident workflows.
Published the complete Enterprise ATT&CK reference and reviewed APT28/APT44 evidence layer.
